summary: Archived Tracks 02 and 03 satisfy the hard-start evidence and privacy contracts; the repository baseline passes 194 tests. Track 05 is a later-phase dependency and its deterministic benchmark contract is locally available, while its generative comparator decision remains pending. Independent contract and synthetic-ingestion work may proceed without clinical interpretation, remote code, model downloads, external inference, or operational promotion.

Implemented five framework-neutral capability contracts and synthetic disclosure probes. Review fix a4c3322 completed the required profile, lifecycle, device, privacy and regulatory fields. Five focused tests and 199 repository tests pass with lint, type, gremlin and governance checks. No upstream framework or model was executed; adapter acquisition and measured device certification remain blocked on decision 20260829-003-track06-adapter-acquisition, so completion and archival are prohibited.

Owner-approved bounded acquisition admitted isolated pydicom 3.0.2 and WFDB 4.3.1 environments with exact installed distribution RECORD hashes, observed licences, uninstall and rollback instructions. Generated synthetic-only probes passed DICOM metadata, pixel-region, direct-identifier removal, burned-in quarantine, series integrity and adversarial-file checks, plus WFDB record, lead, sampling, annotation, timestamp, missing-lead and adversarial-header checks. Receipts e90956734bb77f327aa281a48db8e9a7e57dc7bba2fc96d3e622d033e5377100 and 8c77f1d4fa99c33e562b4ec0e208f9a28e06f6f670716614039e5a91d236780d preserve clinical and diagnostic interpretation as disabled. Document/OCR, encoder, speech, MONAI, noise, resampling and device-variation work remains incomplete, so no support or completion claim is made.
